Dubai: Mumbai's Crime Branch has arrested two former Kanz Aldera staff accused of swapping Rs 55 lakh in gold for fakes, then extorting their old Dubai manager for Rs 50 lakh.

Police allege Barman and Pathar swapped 470 grams of gold for fakes, caught in June, then threatened Dhanak by phone, Free Press Journal reports. Both were arrested this week in different Indian states and remanded; neither has responded publicly.

زعمت الشرطة أن موظفين سابقين في مجوهرات كنز الدرة بديرة دبي استبدلا 470 غراماً من الذهب بقطع مقلدة، ثم طالبا مديرهما بـ50 لاكه روبية مع تهديده بالقتل.
